selected.name: Phoebe Bridgers
selected.description: Phoebe Bridgers is an American singer-songwriter known for her emotive indie rock and folk music.

properties.description: Lucy Dacus is an American singer-songwriter from Richmond, Virginia, celebrated for literate, deeply personal songwriting, a warm alto voice, and arrangements that build from sparse intimacy to cathartic crescendos. She released her debut album No Burden (2016) and followed with critically acclaimed Historian (2018) and Home Video (2021). Dacus is also a founding member of the supergroup boygenius with Phoebe Bridgers and Julien Baker, and she is noted for her narrative lyrics, emotional directness, and influence within modern indie and singer-songwriter circles.

Big Thief is an American four-piece indie rock/folk band formed in Brooklyn in 2015. Anchored by songwriter and singer Adrianne Lenker and guitarist Buck Meek, with Max Oleartchik on bass and James Krivchenia on drums, the band is celebrated for sparse, intimate arrangements, vulnerable storytelling and dynamic shifts between hushed folk and more urgent rock. Their acclaimed albums include Masterpiece (2016), Capacity (2017), U.F.O.F. (2019), Two Hands (2019) and Dragon New Warm Mountain I Believe in You (2022). They gained strong critical praise, steady festival presence and a devoted international indie audience.

Matt Berninger is an American singer-songwriter best known as the lead vocalist and lyricist of the indie rock band The National. His distinctive baritone voice and introspective lyrics have made him a prominent figure in alternative and indie music scenes.

Julien Baker is an American singer-songwriter and guitarist from Memphis, Tennessee, known for her deeply personal and emotional songwriting, sparse arrangements, and haunting vocals. She began her music career in the early 2010s and gained critical acclaim for her introspective lyrics and minimalist style. Baker's music often explores themes of mental health, addiction, faith, and personal struggle, delivered with raw vulnerability and poetic lyricism.

Julia Jacklin is an Australian singer-songwriter and musician known for her intimate and emotionally resonant indie rock and folk music. She has gained critical acclaim for her storytelling ability, blending indie rock and folk influences with personal and introspective lyrics. Jacklin's music often explores themes of relationships, self-discovery, and vulnerability, delivered with a distinctive, emotive vocal style.

AdriAnne Lenker is an American singer-songwriter and musician, best known as the lead vocalist and guitarist of the indie folk band Big Thief. She has also released solo albums showcasing her intimate, acoustic, and poetic songwriting style. Lenker's music is characterized by its emotional depth, delicate melodies, and raw, confessional lyrics. Her work often explores themes of nature, relationships, and personal introspection.

Snail Mail is the stage name of Lindsey Jordan, an American singer-songwriter and guitarist known for her introspective lyrics and melodic indie rock sound. Emerging in the late 2010s, Snail Mail gained critical acclaim for her debut album 'Lush' which showcased her skillful guitar work and emotionally resonant songwriting. Her music blends elements of indie rock, indie pop, and emo, characterized by raw, honest lyricism and a youthful yet mature perspective.

Better Oblivion Community Center is an indie rock supergroup formed in 2019 by American singer-songwriters Conor Oberst and Phoebe Bridgers. The duo combines elements of indie rock and folk to create emotionally resonant music characterized by introspective lyrics and harmonious vocals. Their self-titled debut album was released in 2019 to critical acclaim, noted for its blend of Oberst's seasoned songwriting and Bridgers' distinctive voice.

Suki Waterhouse is an English singer-songwriter, model, and actress who has developed a music career characterized by indie pop and alternative influences. She is known for her ethereal vocal style and introspective songwriting, blending pop sensibilities with alternative and electropop elements. Waterhouse's music often features dreamy melodies and a modern, stylish aesthetic that complements her background in fashion and acting.

Soccer Mommy is the musical project of Sophie Allison, an American singer-songwriter and musician. She gained recognition for her introspective and emotionally resonant indie rock and bedroom pop music, characterized by confessional lyrics and melodic guitar work. Her sound blends elements of indie rock, indie pop, and alternative rock, often exploring themes of youth, relationships, and personal growth.

Beabadoobee (Beatrice Kristi Ilejay Laus) is a Filipino-British singer-songwriter from London who rose from bedroom recordings to international recognition. Her music fuses intimate, guitar-forward bedroom-pop with clear 1990s alternative rock influences, and she is known for plaintive, nostalgic melodies and candid lyrics. She released a series of acclaimed EPs before debuting with Fake It Flowers (2020) and follow-up Beatopia (2022). Her third studio album, This Is How Tomorrow Moves, debuted at No.1 on the UK Official Charts; she has supported her records with sold-out tours across the UK, EU and North America and festival appearances including Coachella. She has collaborated with artists such as Laufey, Clairo, Cavetown, PinkPantheress and Luna Li, and cites influences like Alex G, Karen O and Florist.

Stella Donnelly is an Australian singer-songwriter and musician known for her indie rock and folk-influenced sound. She gained recognition for her candid and socially conscious lyrics, often addressing themes such as gender politics, relationships, and social justice. Donnelly's music features a blend of melodic indie pop and raw, emotive storytelling, marked by her distinctive vocal style and guitar work.

Boygenius is an American indie rock supergroup formed in 2018 by singer-songwriters Julien Baker, Phoebe Bridgers, and Lucy Dacus. The group is known for their harmonious vocals, introspective lyrics, and blending of indie rock and folk influences. They released their debut EP 'boygenius' in 2018 to critical acclaim, showcasing their collaborative songwriting and emotive performances. The band members also maintain successful solo careers alongside their work as Boygenius.

Aldous Harding is a New Zealand singer-songwriter and musician recognized for her unique vocal style and deeply introspective, often haunting folk music. She blends elements of indie folk with art pop and alternative influences, creating a sound that is both intimate and enigmatic. Harding's music is characterized by poetic lyrics, minimalistic arrangements, and a captivating stage presence that often includes theatrical and enigmatic performance elements.

Japanese Breakfast is the creative project fronted by singer-songwriter Michelle Zauner. Originating in the early 2010s, the project blends dream-pop textures, indie-rock dynamics and experimental production with confessional songwriting. Zauner is the primary songwriter and creative force; the recordings and live shows combine lush synths, layered guitars, melodic hooks and moments of intimate vulnerability. Major critically acclaimed releases include Psychopomp (2016), Soft Sounds From Another Planet (2017) and Jubilee (2021).
